services.value: Eurofins provides analytical testing services across multiple areas, including Life (Food & Feed, Environment, Agro, Sensory and Consumer Research), BioPharma (BioPharma Services, Agroscience, Genomic Services, Forensic Services), and Diagnostic Services & Products (including In Vitro Diagnostics Solutions and Clinical Diagnostic Services). It also lists Contract Development & Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO) and PSS Insourcing Solutions®.
